native_splice_architecture.reconstruct_master: fortran_eos/src/compose_eos_reconstruct.f90:763 reconstruct_master subroutine + CLI action 'reconstruct-master' (compose_eos_fortran.f90:180). Reconstructs the cold crust barotrope (outer + inner crust) from the source thermodynamic columns using native PCHIP/Hermite kernels, enforces the first law (mu_B = F + P/n_B), electron/muon/charge constraints, rejects phase-pressure plateaus (one-sided discontinuities retained), and preserves the extra thermo column unless explicitly declared cs2.
native_splice_architecture.match_crust_core: fortran_eos/src/compose_eos_matching.f90:571 match_crust_core subroutine + CLI action 'match-core' (compose_eos_fortran.f90:139). Splices a cold beta-equilibrated crust barotrope to a cold beta-equilibrated core barotrope via the four cubic/quintic F/P Hermite bridge kernels (EOS-05) plus css. Computes endpoint sound speeds (endpoint_cs2), the matching window (find_window), and assembles crust-knots + bridge + core-knots. Validates inputs (validate_eos) and the assembled table (strictly-increasing nb/p/eps).
native_splice_architecture.consistency_gate: fortran_eos/src/compose_eos_verify.f90:47 check_consistency subroutine. Computes the CompOSE C1-C11 consistency record on an EOSData; the native hard gate is C1-C6/C10/C11 (C7-C9 are finite-difference diagnostics). C6 = dP/dn_B > 0, C10 = causal sound speed (0 < cs2 < 1), C11 = dmu_B/dn_B > 0, C1 = cold-T=0 + zero entropy + zero Q6-Q7, C2 = thermodynamic closure.
native_splice_architecture.api_wiring: python_frontend/compose_eos/api.py:281 match_crust_core calls the Fortran match-core action, then check_consistency(matched) (api.py:198) and stores info['consistency']; it raises if consistency['overall']['pass_'] is False (api.py:199-207).

acceptance_criteria_verification.evidence_detail: The assembled crust+core table passes the full native C1-C11 consistency gate (hard checks C1-C6/C10/C11) for all 5 methods: overall=True, C6 (dP/dn_B>0)=True, C10 (0<cs2<1)=True, C11 (dmu_B/dn_B>0)=True, C1 (cold T=0/zero entropy/zero Q6-Q7)=True, C2 (closure)=True. This is the bridge + source-knots combined, not just the bridge. The matching uses endpoint_cs2 (left/right endpoint sound speeds), find_window (matching window with 0.12 < thp,thf < 0.88 interior constraints), and the bridge is strictly increasing in nb/p/eps with 0<cs2<1 across the whole assembled table. This closes the legacy M4 receipt's C6/C10/C11 assembled-table gap on the native path.

The smooth matching path interpolates the thermodynamic barotrope (Q1-Q7) in the bridge but does NOT interpolate categorical composition columns. With drop_composition=True (required for composition-bearing inputs), the assembled table carries zero composition everywhere (Yn/Yp/Ye/Ymu/Aav/Zav/Yh all 0.0) and uniform Iphase=0: the source composition is explicitly discarded, not interpolated into the bridge. The reconstruct-master path preserves the extra thermo column (q_extra) unless explicitly declared cs2 (test_native_master_preserves_extra_thermo_column). Presence masks (test_m2a_presence_masks) preserve explicit-zero and partial composition row-level semantics without interpolation.

The native reconstruct-master rejects a phase-pressure plateau instead of smoothing across it (one-sided discontinuity retained, not interpolated over). The historical 'maxwell' alias is rejected in match_crust_core (it would build a legacy smooth pressure plateau that is not a first-order transition); the sharp first-order transition path is test_native_maxwell_transition. The smooth matching path does not paper over a one-sided jump with a fake plateau.
